title: Kedarnath
reportingPoint: Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi. Departure is around 9:00 PM on the departure night.
highlights: Visit to the Shri Kedarnath shrine
Drive via Devprayag and Rudraprayag along the Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers
Hotel stays at Guptkashi and Kedarnath
overview:
A group trip to Shri Kedarnath from Delhi: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** trip leaves Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi around 9 PM and travels overnight to Guptkashi.

Day 1 follows the Devprayag and Rudraprayag route to Guptkashi, with a visit to the Ardh Narishwar temple and a hotel stay. Day 2 is the drive to Sonprayag, a local jeep to Gaurikund and the 19-20 km trek to Kedarnath, where you visit the shrine and stay the night; a helicopter is the other option, at your own cost. Day 3 returns to Sonprayag and Guptkashi after the morning pooja. Day 4 is the drive back to Delhi after breakfast. Prices start at ₹11,499 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi
itinerary.content:
Report at the departure point and meet our representative.
Leave Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi around 9 PM.
Overnight journey from Delhi to Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Reach Guptkashi
itinerary.content:
Drive up to Guptkashi via the Devprayag and Rudraprayag route, with views of the Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers.
Visit the Ardh Narishwar temple at Guptkashi and offer prayers.
Check in to the hotel and rest for the night.

itinerary.title: Gaurikund to Kedarnath trek (19-20 km)
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive to Sonprayag.
Take a local jeep from Sonprayag to Gaurikund, the starting point of the trek.
Trek from Gaurikund to Kedarnath (19-20 km).
The other way to reach the shrine is by helicopter (cost not included); you are dropped at the helipad in the morning after breakfast.
Tell the driver how long your trek or flight will take, so he can park and pick you up the next day.
Visit the shrine and spend some time at the dham.
Check in to a hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath to Guptkashi
itinerary.content:
After the morning pooja and breakfast, check out of the hotel.
Return from Kedarnath by the same route and take a local jeep to Sonprayag.
The driver picks you up at the pre-decided place for the drive back to Guptkashi.
Check in to the hotel. The rest of the day is free to rest.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi to Delhi
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, start the journey back to Delhi.
The trip ends in Delhi.

importantNotes:
- AC will not work in hilly areas.
- Sightseeing is covered as far as the time frame allows.
- **Carry a valid government-approved photo ID.** There is no boarding without it.
- **The departure time is fixed.** Keep your phone reachable and update your trip coordinator; they will try calling you, but we can't hold the bus.
- Smoking isn't allowed on the bus.
- The itinerary can change because of weather, road conditions or safety. All sightseeing is subject to weather and local authority guidelines.
- On hill roads the driver may switch off the AC or sound system. Safety comes first.
- Travel insurance isn't included. We recommend buying it before the trip.
- Any increase in entry fees, taxes or fuel costs by the government after booking is charged extra.
- Extra costs from delays outside our control (natural calamity, vehicle breakdown, road closures) are borne by travellers.
- Damage to room or camp furnishings is payable by the guest responsible.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Report at the departure point at Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi and meet our representative. The trip leaves around 9 PM for an overnight journey to Guptkashi.

faqs.q: How much does the Kedarnath trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹11,499 per person on quad sharing, ₹11,999 on triple sharing and ₹12,499 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.
Accommodation, transport from Delhi to Delhi for 3 nights and 4 days, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, point-to-point sightseeing as per the programme, and all tolls, taxes, parking and driver allowances.

faqs.q: How do we reach Kedarnath from Guptkashi?
faqs.a: You are driven to Sonprayag, take a local jeep to Gaurikund and trek from there to Kedarnath, which the itinerary lists as 19-20 km. You return by the same route the next day.

faqs.q: Can I take a helicopter instead of trekking?
faqs.a: Yes, but helicopter tickets are not included in the package. If you choose the helicopter, you are dropped at the helipad in the morning after breakfast. Porters or mules for luggage are also extra, at ₹350 per day per bag of up to 12 kg.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
